Returns matching products with ID, name, SKU, kind (equipment or software), product page URL, image URL, short descriptio

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns the full public details of one product in the ConductScience catalog by the numeric ID from search_products: description, specifications, categories, stock status, product page URL, image URL and, for equipment, the price in US dollars when one is published, with the same price_type values a
